description: Land Acquisition - Pahala Gettuwana, Mallawapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, containing detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their extents, boundaries, and ownership claims for public purpose acquisition. It falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it deals primarily with land matters and property acquisitions, not government personnel changes or structural modifications.
